title: Keep telecommunications data as the data retention scheme requires
what: Providers of services to which Part 5-1A applies must keep prescribed information and documents about communications for the specified period.

sources.title: Telecommunications (Interception and Access) Act 1979
sources.quote: 187A Service providers must keep certain information and documents (1) A person (a service provider) who operates a service to which this Part applies (a relevant service) must keep, or cause to be kept, in accordance with section 187BA and for the period specified in section 187C:

reach.condition: if it operates a service to which Part 5-1A applies
